title: Burned Feathers
subtitle: A bird flies on more than wings alone.

trails.title: Low on Supplies
trails.description: Time to tighten our belts, soldiers.

content.text:
A Brief Overview of Teleport Disk Usage in the Current Era

1. General Situation
Headquarters's teleport disk supply across all departments is critically low. As a single-use item with a limited capacity per teleportation, emergency rationing remains in effect based on current inventory. Priority is given to frontline and core mission units. Requests for additional supplies will not be approved outside of special emergencies or critical needs.

2. Cause and Background
The only known source of the primary materials for teleport disks is located in the core conflict zone of the ongoing war. Extraction operations have been fully suspended, and supply routes remain blocked. As a result of these uncontrollable factors, teleport disk production has dropped significantly, inventory continues to decline, and resupply remains uncertain.

3. Conclusion
Due to the disruption of material supplies, teleport disk stocks have entered a critical shortage. The Laplace Scientific Computing Center is actively researching substitute materials. Headquarters requires all departments to strictly adhere to rationing standards and optimize usage strategy. All combat objectives must be carefully evaluated, with disks reserved for critical junctures capable of turning the tide of battle, in order to manage current and future supply pressures.

items.text: Burned Feathers
Matilda dodges nimbly around the cascade of rubble. She can see the cracks forming over the cement ceiling, leading to only one conclusion.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: That explosion came from the top of the tower. No, it can't be. They must be targeting the Shelter Dove.
The believers freeze, then as if summoned, they raise their heads.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: If it's damaged, then this corner of the school will be exposed to the "Storm." If any students happen to be around ...
An enemy—a humanoid husk shrouded in black—descends. Its bizarre, hulking movements manage to be even more unsettling than those of the disciples.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: What now?
The figure raises its hand, pointing toward Matilda. A black vortex condenses at its fingertip.
The vortex's impact dissolves the once-sturdy concrete as if it were foam, only narrowly missing its intended target.
Matilda teeters at the edge of this new hole. But gravity finds her, and she tumbles downward.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Whoaaa!
Air Raid Shelter
Pain. Her first sensation is pain. It comes, sharp and certain, as she struggles to catch her breath.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: *cough* This is the underground shelter. *cough*
The hard fall leaves her head muddled, vision flickering and ears ringing.
*chirp*

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: *chirp*
As the floor above Matilda crumbles away, a little bird darts over the rubble toward her.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: *chirp-chirp*
Merel dispels the transformation in a less-than-elegant fashion, then hurries to her comrade's side.
She can hear the enemy's footsteps above them, but the falling shards of cement and billowing dust obscures her vision.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Matilda! Can you hear me? Wake up!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Hang in there. I'll get these concrete blocks out of here in no time.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Alright. Let's—
Another attack thunders down from above. It grazes Merel's face, but before she can turn, she hears a scream as more cement tumbles down toward them.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: No! No, no, no, no, no, Matilda!
She lunges over to Matilda and, gathering all her strength, drags her from the rubble before the next attack can hit.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: We have to move!
Broom Closet, Air Raid Shelter
Merel throws herself and her unconscious companion into a small, dark room.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Is this a broom closet? Alright, it'll at least take that thing some time to find us in here.
She takes a moment to recall her field first aid protocols, then lays Matilda down gently.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Please don't die. Can you hear me, Matilda?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Phew! At least she's still breathing.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Alright, let's see. Some bruises, no obvious fractures or internal bleeding.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Hm? What are these?
Several dull-looking shards have buried themselves in Matilda's clothes.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Are they crystals?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: No, no, no, no, no, no. Focus, damn it. You can't get distracted.
Thoughts bombard her from every direction, but whether it's the adrenaline or some spark of confidence, she finds her center.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: First, hide Matilda somewhere safe. Second, get the backup Dove to protect us from the Storm Syndrome.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Then, take Matilda to the central watchtower or the library and wait for rescue. That's the plan.
Her heart beats faster, stronger, but steady.
With deep breaths, she gets her trembling under control. Fear transforms into resolve, her mind and body reacting in sync like never before.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I can do this. I'm a soldier. I've trained for this.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Alright. Action.
Warehouse, Air Raid Shelter

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: The backup ... It's here. Oh, good thing I was actually listening when Matilda mentioned them.
She breathes out some relief when her Security Assistance Team key is enough to open the locked safe.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Hm. I doubt these can cover the same range without a pedestal. I'd better hurry back.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Who's there?
Cradling the Shelter Dove, she leans close against the door, listening for movement outside.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: More Manus. Have they attacked the entire campus? I hope everyone's safe.
Waiting until the footsteps recede into silence, Merel slowly inches the storage room door open.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Who knows what I'll run into on my way back. Maybe I should cast invisibility on myself? But that would leave optical traces.
She racks her brain for a solution, silently cursing that she never practices these lesser-used arcane skills.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Hmm. Maybe there's something in here I can use as a disguise. Oh, how about that locker?
She crouches down and runs a hand over the sturdy metal locker.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Huh? What are you doing in here?

items.speaker: Student
items.text: I ... I snuck out to meet Moss and Randy. We-We were going to meet ...
The sealed, empty space amplifies the approaching footsteps.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Ah, bollocks!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Stay there. Don't make a sound.
She closes the door with haste and dives behind a stack of supply boxes.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I've never seen a Manus soldier like this before. What sort of weapon are they using?
Taking notice of the rustling, the dark figure lifts its finger and points toward a locker.

items.speaker: Rat
items.text: *squeak*
A rat scurries out from inside.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: That power ... Never mind. Looks like they don't even need one.
It follows the rat's movements and targets another locker.
Another raise of a hand.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Let me save you some trouble. I'm over here.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Are they dead?
The enemy falls, but Merel keeps her sights trained on it, watching with disgust as inky matter flows out from its broken "skull."

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: No, this isn't a person. It's something artificial.
Several heartbeats pass, but the enemy doesn't stir. Confident in her victory, she stows her weapon.

items.speaker: Student
items.text: *sob*
Beverly rushes out from his hiding place.

items.speaker: Student
items.text: What-What was that?
Merel grabs his head and forces him to look away.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Don't look. We'll ... We'll figure out what's going on. Just come with me for now.
Something snatches away the Shelter Dove she's holding.
The loathsome creature rises to its feet, still missing half its skull. The inky void where it should be forms into eldritch tentacles as it pulls itself together.
It holds the stolen Dove in a vise grip, and with its other hand, it conjures another black vortex.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Get down!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Ugh, what?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: V-Vertin? Sonetto!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Merel, take cover!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It looks like their arcane skills can't pass through the crystals conjured by my incantations.
Her assessment is as calm and composed as ever, even under fire.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Which means I should be able to provide us protection going forward.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Its core is inside its head, Sonetto. Can you see it?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see it—a breach in its skull. Maybe we can start by disabling its perception of Gnosis.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But I need to get closer before I can cast accurately.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Closer? I can help with that. Cover me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Understood.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Merel, are you alright?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I'm fine.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Where's Matilda?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: She's ...

items.speaker: Student
items.text: *sob*
The cowering Beverly, no longer able to suppress his terror, wipes away tears as he sobs.

items.speaker: Student
items.text: Will-Will it come back to life again?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry. We've shattered its core. It won't come back.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Come here. What's your name?

items.speaker: Student
items.text: Beverly ...
Sonetto leads the terrified student away and comforts him.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What happened to Matilda, Merel?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: She got injured badly. She's unconscious. The best I could do was hide her in a broom closet. I'll take you to her.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: But how did you both get here so quickly?
Registration Desk, St. Pavlov Foundation

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Teleport disks?

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Yes. A Laplace researcher gave the Timekeeper two disks when the alarm rang.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: She and her assistant used them to get to the SPDM.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: How many more of these unregistered disks are there in the LSCC?
Yermolai waves his own complaints away. It isn't worth considering now.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Attacking headquarters is one thing, but the SPDM? What crooked reason could they have to hurt those kids?

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Are they so desperate to replace their losses that they'd kidnap school children?

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: War makes monsters of us all, even more so for the Manus. Wait, that's where Blackbird was stationed. I hope she's alright.
Paravyan tries his best to analyze the situation.

items.speaker: Paravyan
items.text: The Timekeeper made the right choice. With her leadership and her assistant by her side, she should be able to keep things under control until reinforcement arrives.

items.speaker: Captain Osborn
items.text: Dispatch has given us our instructions. Right, Ms. Stranger?
The captain of the First Squad comes over.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Yes. You will reinforce the SPDM with the First Squad. Meanwhile, I will mobilize the reserves and take over security here.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Creius picked a great time to get hauled off to court. Where are the Flying Witches?

items.speaker: Captain Osborn
items.text: The nearest flight unit is on its way from Zeno headquarters, but only those who are equipped with Equilibrium Umbrellas.

items.speaker: Captain Osborn
items.text: There's no doubt we'll be the first unit to reach the SPDM. Those children are counting on us.

items.speaker: Captain Osborn
items.text: Ms. Stranger, please continue the admission process. The chaos in the SPDM can't be allowed to spread to headquarters.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: First Squad assembled. Captain Osborn, we're ready to go!

items.speaker: Captain Osborn
items.text: Alright! Get moving!
